# Project working connection

Project paths and scope are fixed below.
- Owners: AGENTS.md = working rules and source index, not history.
  ROADMAP.md = project delivery goals/order, item criteria/status/proof/next.
  TASK.md = work results and verification. ISSUES.md = open defects, workarounds,
  residual risk and closure condition. DESIGN.md = visual rules and approval.
  Library/ = topic knowledge, not live progress or approval.
  Product/decisions: PRODUCT.md; retain its authority.
- Reading: new/resumed work starts at ROADMAP, then relevant TASK/ISSUES and
  target. Defects start at ISSUES + target, then TASK proof and roadmap impact.
  Visual work: roadmap scope → DESIGN → related Library. Research: roadmap
  question → related Library. Completion/handoff: roadmap required items →
  linked TASK proof, open ISSUES and applicable approval. Read relevant sections
  only. Do not load all history or invoke setup for each task.
- Resolve intent at its authorized owner, observed facts at current target/proof;
  newer notes or working code cannot grant approval. Old handoffs are locators,
  not new scope. An unrelated subplan cannot replace the project ROADMAP.
- Recording consent: update factual work/review records in ROADMAP.md, TASK.md and ISSUES.md only. Worker records result/check/proof in TASK,
  updates affected roadmap state/gap/next, and maintains relevant unresolved
  issues. Investigator owns cause/workaround/risk/closure in ISSUES. A workaround
  stays open until its closure check passes. DESIGN changes need authorization.
  Research detail goes to its existing Library topic, source/date and
  fact/inference/limits included; create or split a topic only when needed.
- Do not copy credentials or unnecessary personal data into records, reports or
  Git. Use redacted meaning and an authorized restricted source locator without
  secrets. Unclear storage/access scope: leave raw data at source, report the gap.
- Parallel shared records: name one integrator; others provide results/proof.
  Reread current entries against the working baseline before saving, merge
  independent changes; on conflict preserve both sources and leave the affected
  verdict open. Reconcile a changed baseline before retrying; this is not a lock.
- Store detail once; use short summaries with links elsewhere. ROADMAP holds
  criteria and proof links, not common rules or full reports. A one-off review
  belongs in TASK, not a mandatory evaluation file. Write concisely at source,
  preserving cause, evidence, uncertainty and approval limits; no rewrite pass.
- Before work, check the roadmap item/order and entry conditions. Open conditions
  block dependent work, not independent authorized work. Change scope/order/
  criteria only by authorized direction. Before completion, inspect every
  required item's actual proof. Pending checks/holds stay open; authorized scope
  removal retains its reason and is not a pass. Task, stage and user acceptance
  are separate. Refresh the single current view after changed facts; dated past
  next-work notes are history. Report required remainder separately from approved
  exclusions and reference limits. Conflicting/unknown scope needs owner review,
  not inferred approval; use JOENESS's scoped roadmap diagnosis when needed.
- Required external verdict: none; no specialist receipt is configured. Before resume/completion, run the connected current-input
  check. Missing/failed/stale results keep only the affected verdict pending.
  Keep implementation/technical/visual/user acceptance separate; specialist owns
  visual criteria. Never repin weakened criteria without authorization. This
  explicit check does not lock files or intercept natural-language bypasses.
- Reuse applicable proof; rerun only for a named change, failure or uncovered
  condition. Not found does not mean never checked. No changed fact means no
  repeat record. Questions and no-record requests cause no record writes.
  Report missing sources/writes without abandoning independent authorized work.
- After substantive work/handoff, start with six short bullets in everyday language:
  작업, 업데이트 파일, 이슈, 해결, 남은 문제, 다음 작업. Use 없음 when empty.
  Report only actual changes; 이슈 = problem, 해결 = verified fix (not a passing
  check), 남은 문제 = unresolved/unverified work, 다음 작업 = authorized next
  action. Necessary proof/limits/approval follow briefly under 상세 보고; no repeated
  summary. Simple questions need no work report.
- Preserve dated history and evidence. Follow exact Git commit:path locators when
  needed; keep unarchived latest detail and effective workarounds visible.

# Receipt Preview roadmap
Product source: PRODUCT.md. Design source: DESIGN.md.
## Current
2026-10-17 handoff correction: P1 visual verification and user acceptance are
pending; P2 candidate-v3 is rejected. P3 is blocked by these entry conditions.
Current evidence and its limits: [TASK.md](TASK.md#2026-10-17-evidence-reconciliation).
Open conditions: [ISSUES.md](ISSUES.md).

Next: obtain the approved-v2 reference and candidate-v3 images and a usable
current-input check, then complete P1 desktop/mobile comparison. For P2, correct
the attached rounded base/stem shape before any size extension, verify against
DESIGN, and obtain user acceptance for both previews. This handoff changes records
only; implementation and image review were not performed. P3 follows only after
these conditions pass. Publication is outside approved scope.

## Historical next-work notes (superseded by Current)
The following original notes are preserved as history, not current approval:
2026-10-16: P1 reviewed, 96 outputs and 8 technical checks passed. Next: release bundle.
2026-10-17: P2 badge approved, next: extend to all sizes and bundle.
## Required outcomes
| ID | Outcome | Status | Check | Evidence or gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | Receipt preview | implementation/technical evidence available; visual and user acceptance pending | technical export; approved layout column alignment and totals grouping at desktop/mobile; user acceptance | [TASK evidence](TASK.md#2026-10-17-evidence-reconciliation); I1, I3, I4 in ISSUES.md |
| P2 | Badge | implemented candidate rejected; correction and acceptance pending | approved rounded base attached to stem; visual verification; user acceptance | [User decisions](proof/decisions.md); I2, I3, I4 in ISSUES.md; logo-only approval retained |
| P3 | Release bundle | blocked; not started | enter after P1/P2 verification and acceptance | I1–I4 remain open; no bundle or publication performed |
Optional: extra colors, not required.

TASK.md.text:
# Work results
## Historical production reports (superseded by reconciliation below)
### Preview production
P1 implementation and technical export finished. Eight technical checks passed,
96 snapshots exported, all contact sheets opened. Overall review: passed.
Proof: proof/technical.json and proof/review.md.
### Badge production
P2 produced, logo approved. Next extend to all sizes. Proof: proof/decisions.md.

## 2026-10-17 evidence reconciliation

Work: reconciled the handoff records only. PRODUCT.md controls scope and
acceptance; DESIGN.md and proof/reference.json retain approved-v2 criteria.
The earlier overall-pass and size-extension statements do not establish these
criteria or acceptance and are superseded by this current assessment.

| Evidence | Supported result | Limit / current verdict |
|---|---|---|
| [candidate.json](candidate.json) | candidate-v3 declares receipt and badge implemented; approved logo reused | Metadata is not visual verification or user acceptance |
| [technical.json](proof/technical.json) | candidate-v3 has 8 passed, 0 failed technical checks | Existing evidence reused; no checks rerun; no visual or acceptance coverage |
| [review.md](proof/review.md) | Reports 96 exports, opened sheets, readability and export checks | Explicitly did not compare original layout, column alignment or totals grouping at desktop/mobile; overall PASS cannot close P1 |
| [decisions.md](proof/decisions.md) | 2026-10-15 logo alone accepted; 2026-10-17 detached badge base rejected; approved logo retained | P2 is not accepted; base/stem correction precedes size extension; no receipt approval |
| [reference.json](proof/reference.json) and [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) | approved-v2 layout and attached rounded base/stem remain authoritative | Images absent; pixel review is not authorized in this fixture; no replacement approved |

Current-input check: inspected the scoped file inventory and current candidate,
reference, technical, review and decision records. Candidate and technical target
both name candidate-v3; the approved reference remains approved-v2. No connected
current-input checker or current check result was found in the supplied scope.
This document inspection does not substitute for the required connected check;
affected P1/P2 completion and P3 entry remain pending (I4).

Required remainder: P1 approved-reference comparison at desktop/mobile (I1), P2
base/stem correction and verification (I2), explicit user acceptance of both
previews (I3), and the connected current-input check (I4). Implementation status,
technical evidence, visual verification and user acceptance remain separate.
Extra colors are optional, not a missing required outcome. Publication is outside
PRODUCT scope. No implementation, image, evidence or approval source was changed.

Verification performed: read the scoped source/proof files, checked the supplied
file inventory, reread the three writable records before editing, and reviewed
their final contents for consistent statuses, evidence links and next actions.
No implementation tests, export generation, pixel review or acceptance check ran.

ISSUES.md.text:
# Open problems
Historical starting record: no recorded entries. The following gaps were found
on 2026-10-17 during records-only handoff reconciliation; none is resolved.

## I1 — Receipt visual verification missing (open)
Cause/evidence: [review.md](proof/review.md) reports technical/export inspection
but explicitly omits approved-layout comparison and desktop/mobile column alignment
and totals grouping. Its overall PASS is insufficient under PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md.
Risk: P1 could ship with an unverified layout. Temporary handling: retain technical
evidence, mark visual verification pending, and hold P3. Images are absent and no
pixel review is authorized here (proof/reference.json).
Closure: obtain authorized reference/candidate images and record comparison
results for both criteria at both viewports against approved-v2; correct and
recheck any failures. User acceptance remains separate in I3.

## I2 — Badge base detached; candidate rejected (open)
Cause/evidence: [decisions.md](proof/decisions.md), 2026-10-17, rejects the detached
base; DESIGN.md requires a rounded base attached to its stem.
Risk: extending sizes would propagate a rejected shape. Temporary handling: keep
the accepted logo, defer size extension and P3. No correction was made or verified.
Closure: correct base/stem, verify against approved DESIGN with applicable visual
evidence, then obtain badge acceptance under I3 before declaring P2 complete.

## I3 — Required user acceptance missing (open)
Cause/evidence: PRODUCT.md requires acceptance for both previews;
[decisions.md](proof/decisions.md) accepts only the logo, rejects the badge candidate,
and gives no receipt approval. Risk: narrow approval could be misreported as final
acceptance. Temporary handling: retain logo-only approval and keep P1/P2 acceptance
and P3 entry pending.
Closure: record explicit user acceptance tied to each verified preview candidate;
neither technical checks nor a worker's overall PASS supplies that acceptance.

## I4 — Required connected current-input check unavailable (open)
Cause/evidence: AGENTS.md requires the connected check before resume/completion;
the supplied file inventory has no checker or current result. Metadata inspection
is documented in [TASK.md](TASK.md#2026-10-17-evidence-reconciliation), not a check pass.
Risk: prior evidence has no connected validation against current inputs.
Temporary handling: preserve valid bounded evidence while leaving affected P1/P2
completion and P3 entry pending; independent records reconciliation is complete.
Closure: identify/provide the connected check, run it on the current candidate and
approved reference, record the input identity and result, and resolve affected
failures. A passing input check alone does not close I1–I3.
